title: 49ers likely won't cut Brandon Aiyuk until they have to

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers likely won't cut Brandon Aiyuk until they have to
sources.description: With a roster exemption that lasts until November 24 and with no requirement to pay him a penny until the exemption expires, the 49ers have shown no inclination to release receiver Brandon Aiyuk until they absolutely have to.
